newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Aluvic posts A$34 mln pre-abnormal net profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Aluvic posts A$34 mln pre-abnormal net profit.

text.p: Government-owned Aluminium Smelters of Victoria Ltd (Aluvic) reported on Wednesday a 6.5 percent rise in pre-abnormal net profit to A$34.2 million for the 1995/96 year to June 30.
Aluvic, which owns 25 percent of the Portland aluminium joint venture, called the result positive and attributed it to the company's foreign exchange and aluminium-price hedging.

The exchange rate achieved in 1995/96 was 9.5 percent below the average spot rate, and the aluminium price achieved was US$1,818 per tonne, a premium of almost US$150 per tonne on the London Metals Exchange (LME) cash price in 1995/96, Aluvic said.
The Portland smelter produced 293,360 tonnes of aluminium in 1995/96. Aluvic's share was 73,341 tonnes.

The other Portland joint venturers are Alcoa of Australia Ltd with 45 percent, Marubeni Corp (10 percent), China International Trust and Investment Corp (10 percent) and Eastern Aluminium (10 percent).
Aluvic is owned by the state of Victoria and acts as a holding company for the state's aluminium industry interests.
